title: SSC CHSL Tier 2 Descriptive — 09 Jan 2022
subTitle: Official Descriptive Paper (Pen & Paper Mode, 100 Marks)

questions.questionText:
Write an essay in English on the following topic:
"The Advantages and Disadvantages of Living in a Metropolitan City"
questions.explanation: Descriptive writing evaluation based on relevance, structure, vocabulary, and argument coherence.
questions.modelSolution:
Metropolitan cities are the economic and cultural engines of modern nations. They offer unparalleled employment
opportunities, world-class healthcare, advanced educational institutions, and sophisticated infrastructure. The multicultural
environment promotes diversity, personal growth, and exposure to global standards. Commuting convenience through modern
metro transit, vibrant nightlife, and rich entertainment avenues make metropolitan life highly aspirational for millions.
However, this urban allure comes with severe drawbacks. Rapid and unplanned urbanization has led to acute overcrowding,
soaring real estate prices, and a stressful cost of living. Millions endure grueling daily traffic jams, high noise levels, and
hazardous air pollution, causing chronic health complications like respiratory illnesses and hypertension. Moreover, the
hyper-competitive pace often erodes communal bonds, fostering loneliness and social isolation.
Furthermore, slums proliferated alongside luxury skyscrapers highlight deep economic inequalities. Overburdened public
services, waste management crises, and water shortages frequently plague urban governance.
In conclusion, while metropolitan cities unlock unparalleled avenues for career and social advancement, they demand a heavy
toll on health, peace of mind, and quality of life. Sustainable urban planning, decentralization, and green infrastructure are
imperative to make metropolitan living truly holistic and livable.
rubrics: Relevance to Topic & Conceptual Clarity (15 Marks)
Structure, Coherence & Flow of Ideas (15 Marks)
Adherence to Word Limit & Format Guidelines (10 Marks)

questions.questionText:
You are Hemdev / Hema, resident of Mohd. Kazi Kareem Nagar, Post Office - Haider Pur,
Muzaffarnagar (Pin: 251001). Write a letter to the Municipal Councillor of your area drawing attention to
the increasing population of stray dogs in the locality and the serious problems arising from it.
questions.explanation: Formal letter evaluation based on official format, civic address, conciseness, and tone.
questions.modelSolution:
Mohd. Kazi Kareem Nagar,
Post Office - Haider Pur,
Muzaffarnagar - 251001.

9th January, 2022.

The Municipal Councillor,
Ward No. 12,
Muzaffarnagar Municipal Corporation,
Muzaffarnagar, Uttar Pradesh.

Subject: Growing menace of stray dogs and urgent request for municipal intervention.

Respected Sir/Madam,

I am a resident of Mohd. Kazi Kareem Nagar and wish to draw your immediate attention to the alarming rise in the stray dog population in our locality.

In recent weeks, packs of stray dogs have made commuting hazardous for residents, particularly young schoolchildren and elderly citizens during morning and evening hours. Several minor dog bite incidents have been reported, creating widespread fear and panic. Furthermore, the constant barking at night severely disturbs the peace of the neighborhood.

I kindly request the municipal authorities to implement a systematic Animal Birth Control (ABC) drive and anti-rabies vaccination campaign in our ward without delay. Your prompt intervention in safely relocating aggressive strays will restore safety and hygiene in the area.

Thanking you.

Yours faithfully,
Hemdev
rubrics: Relevance to Topic & Conceptual Clarity (15 Marks)
Structure, Coherence & Flow of Ideas (15 Marks)
Adherence to Word Limit & Format Guidelines (10 Marks)
